name: Karak chai
description: Black tea boiled hard with evaporated milk, sugar and cardamom.

tcm.note: Black tea plus long boiling plus warm spice.

ayurveda.note: Ushna; the milk does not offset the tea and spice.

histamine.note: Black tea is moderate; the long boil and the tinned milk both add.

stimulant.note: Black tea, long boiled, heavy with milk and sugar.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.

effects.note: Trials pairing L-theanine with caffeine report calmer, steadier attention than caffeine alone — the doses studied run supplement-strength, above what milk, sugar and dilution leave in a cup like this one. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
